vehicle_count_basis.vehicles_per_satellite: same fixed number at every satellite within a size class; selected by user

design_basis: One profile per small/medium/large class, independent of the exact customer count within a class.
Observed fixed-assignment per-satellite single-batch maxima: weight 158/275/535 and boxes 9/15/30.
Rounded E1 capacities cover those unsplittable satellite demands; this is a feasibility screen, not a complete routing proof.
E1 counts 2/3/5 cover the maximum number of satellites in each class; E2 counts are 2/3/5 per satellite.
E2 weight limits are below volume_capacity times the maximum loaded-box weight in each class, so volume does not automatically imply the weight constraint.
No objectives, optimal pools, speedups or preferred model rankings were used to select these draft values.
unchanged: customers, goods weights, one-box demand, coordinates and assignments
delivery and pickup windows, release/use/service times and cycle
box weight 2, box volume 1, speed 2, cleaning and trip rules
economic coefficients, batch definitions and solver implementations
